title: How I write software with LLMs - Hacker News Discussion
description: Extensive discussion on Hacker News about LLM-assisted software development workflows. Key insights: Multi-agent pipelines (architect→developer→reviewer) are debated - some find them effective while others argue single strong models work just as well. Cost comparison shows single-prompt approaches can be 40x cheaper ($0.30 vs $12). Developers emphasize that LLMs require different workflows than humans - context management is crucial. Experience with code review correlates with better LLM results. Security concerns raised about AI-generated code quality. The discussion reveals wide variance in LLM effectiveness based on prompting approach and user expertise.
author: Hacker News Community
